column1: # cubes/synergy-fic-pool.tsv — the seed pool for an evolve of the Synergy Cube with the counters cards of
# Justin's Final Fantasy X Commander deck, Counter Blitz (Final Fantasy Commander, FIC, 2025): every one of its
# nonland cards of at most two colours (evolve adds no three-colour card) that is a +1/+1 counters card or
# removal, less the three the cube already has (Hardened Scales, Tireless Tracker, Walking Ballista).
# theme_tags use the cube's own codes; sources: fic = new in Final Fantasy, fic-reprint = reprinted there.
# forge_supported and forge_ai_flag are placeholders: the engine's own facts replace them at the run (enrichPool),
# so a card Forge 2.0.14 lacks is never added.
